description: Revokes a user's auth tokens (all, or the one auth_token given), so they must sign in with a new token. The user and their data are kept.

auth_token.description: Only this token (optional; default: all of the user's tokens)

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has explicitly agreed to this change. Without it, nothing happens and you get a summary to show them.

name: cometchat_revoke_auth_tokens

revoked.description: all, one, or none (the user had no tokens)

title: Revoke a user's auth tokens
